description: This file contains utility functions for Android development tasks, including process management with adb, log parsing, port finding, and temporary file creation. It also defines some helper functions for message logging and process identification.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message to stderr and exits with status 1.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints a warning message to stderr.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Prints an informational message to stderr.

methods.name: do_adb
methods.description: Wrapper function to execute adb commands with optional options.

methods.name: get_last_logcat_timestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the most recent log line from logcat.

methods.name: resolve_pid
methods.description: Resolves a process name or PID to a PID, using adb if necessary.

methods.name: find_open_port
methods.description: Finds an available network port starting from a given port number.

methods.name: make_temp_file
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with a timestamped name in the system temp directory.
